legal_name: SUPER SCIENTIFIC WORKS PRIVATE LIMITED (as claimed; not independently verified against MCA master data)
note: Registry data could not be retrieved. Tooling failures during this run: DuckDuckGo search backend returned 'Connection refused' on all queries; Bing returned only generic 'super' dictionary/commercial results and ignored the quoted company name; zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com and mca.gov.in/mcafoportal all returned HTTP 403 Forbidden; tofler.in returned 404 for the guessed slug; instafinancials.com returned 404. Therefore CIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, registered-office state, MCA status and audited revenue (FY25/FY26) are all null — not public/not retrieved, and NOT invented. No basis to reject: absence of retrieved records is not evidence of non-existence, strike-off, liquidation or bankruptcy, so the entity is retained in the database pending a re-check. Role left as 'unknown' because no MCA business-activity code or GST/plant evidence was obtained; the claimed industry (oil & gas / chemicals) and HS 848180 (valves) are unverified. Note also that the input gives no claimed state, so the registered-state comparison cannot be performed. Recommended next step: re-run against MCA master data / GST public search once network access to those portals is available.
